snippet.description:
How did AIR 207 Sugandha Gupta manage to complete her UPSC Mains Optional paper on time?

Sugandha shares how repeated test practice helped build muscle memory, allowing her to write faster and organise her thoughts under exam pressure without constantly worrying about paper completion.

The lesson for UPSC aspirants: Practise consistently so that answer writing becomes second nature.

snippet.description:
Feeling lethargic, confused, or losing direction in your UPSC Mains 2027 preparation? If you're starting to feel that there's no point continuing Mains preparation before Prelims, this video is for you.

Sonia Ma’am shares a practical UPSC time management strategy to help you plan your day, set realistic targets, balance GS and Optional, and use the next 80 days effectively. Learn how to rebuild your routine, stay consistent, and get your Mains preparation back on track by December.

Your preparation doesn't need to be perfect. It needs a comeback.

Book 1:1 Mentorship with Sonia Ma'am: https://shorturl.at/Z7jBL
